source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
source_registry.authority: Primary issuer Form 10-Q embedded in 424B3 prospectus supplement
claims_supported: Since inception through September 30, 2026, Evernorth reported $214.1 million cash and 261,919,096 XRP relating to private-placement subscription agreements; the $214.1 million cash was used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP.

As of September 30, 2026, Evernorth reported approximately 346,284,972 XRP, $91,397 unrestricted cash, $341,887,231 digital assets at carrying value, $524,259,563 refundable investor advances, and a $32,870,033 nine-month net loss.

At the October 9, 2026 business-combination closing, Evernorth reported approximately $272.6 million aggregate gross cash proceeds before transaction expenses, comprising approximately $224.6 million from private-placement investments and $48.0 million released from the SPAC trust account; investors also contributed approximately 388,910,554 XRP in kind.

On October 13, 2026, Evernorth issued $30.0 million principal amount of convertible notes and received approximately $30.0 million gross proceeds before transaction expenses; a separate filing describes approximately $29.0 million net proceeds after a $1.0 million advisor fee.

From October 12 through November 9, 2026, holders exercised 3,073,366 warrants for cash; Evernorth issued the same number of Class A shares and received approximately $35.3 million gross. The filing reports 8,666,279 warrants remaining outstanding after those exercises.
At the October 9 closing, Evernorth assumed 11,739,645 warrants in total, each with an $11.50 exercise price. The 3,073,366 exercised plus 8,666,279 remaining reconcile exactly to this aggregate.

An optional equity line of credit permitted up to 5,218,935 Class A shares at 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to conditions and issuer purchase notices; the filing does not establish that the full facility, or any particular draw, was funded.

The filing separately describes 239,653 Sponsor Warrants; the separate November 17 public-warrant supplement registers up to 11,499,992 shares issuable upon exercise of Public Warrants. These are separate warrant classes within the 11,739,645 total assumed at closing.
limitations: The September 30 financial statements predate the October 9 business-combination closing; do not treat pre-close balance-sheet figures as post-close consolidated cash.
Gross cash proceeds are not net cash available after transaction costs, advisory/placement fees, debt, working capital and other uses.
In-kind XRP contributions are not cash proceeds and must not be counted as cash capital.
The optional equity line is capacity, not evidence of funded proceeds; no draw is established by this filing.
The filing's XRP holdings and capital statements are issuer-reported, not independently audited on-chain wallet reconciliation in this research record.

source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
source_registry.authority: Primary issuer Form 8-K/A and attached Pathfinder financial statements
claims_supported: The business combination was consummated on October 9, 2026; Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC became a subsidiary of Evernorth.
Before the transaction, Pathfinder was a wholly owned subsidiary of Ripple.

Ripple contributed 126,791,458 XRP to Pathfinder under a contribution agreement; the filing describes the contribution as a common-control transaction recorded at Ripple's historical carrying value of zero.
RippleWorks contributed 211,319,096 XRP to Arrington XRP Capital Fund, LP, which then contributed the XRP as subscription consideration for Evernorth shares.
A Ripple-affiliated contributor entity transferred 50,000,000 XRP under a separate subscription agreement.

Certain investors affiliated with SBI Holdings amended their advance-funding subscription agreements so Class A issuance was capped at a 39.9% ownership threshold; excess shares were issued as Class C.

Pathfinder's September 30, 2026 statements report $1,490,951 cash, $3,732,611 nine-month net loss, $7,000,000 related-party note payable, $3,562,118 related-party receivable and $2,255,857 related-party payable.
limitations: Pathfinder's September 30 statements are subsidiary-only and pre-close; do not combine them with Evernorth consolidated balances without eliminating intercompany items.
The 39.9% threshold concerns Class A ownership, not 39.9% of total economic ownership or all share classes.
RippleWorks, Arrington Capital, SBI-affiliated investors and Ripple are distinct legal persons/entities; do not collapse their contributions into one Ripple cash purchase.
The XRP contributions are in-kind asset contributions, not cash proceeds.

source_registry.publisher: Pathfinder Digital Assets LLC via SEC EDGAR
source_registry.authority: Primary issuer MD&A, Exhibit 99.2 to Evernorth Form 8-K/A
claims_supported: Pathfinder's post-close role is the entity through which Evernorth conducts XRP treasury and yield-generating activities.
Pathfinder reported no revenue before closing and a $3.7 million nine-month net loss; it reported $1.5 million unrestricted cash and a $5.1 million net working-capital deficit at September 30, 2026.
Pathfinder states Coinbase is its principal market for XRP financial-reporting purposes after assessing trading volume/activity, price consistency and stability, and compliance accessibility.

Pathfinder's strategy discusses potential at-market XRP purchases, yield strategies, and possible secured financing using XRP as collateral; these are described as plans or possibilities, not proof that such activity is already live.
The filing says Ripple was the primary liquidity source through contributed XRP and related-party facilities.
limitations: Coinbase being the principal accounting market does not establish Coinbase custody of Pathfinder or Evernorth XRP.
Potential collateralized financing and yield strategies are not evidence of an executed loan, encumbrance, deployed position or realized yield.
Historical financial results predate the business-combination closing.

source_registry.publisher: Evernorth Holdings Inc. via SEC EDGAR
claims_supported: The prospectus relates to up to 11,499,992 Class A shares issuable upon exercise of Public Warrants at $11.50 per share.
Evernorth receives no proceeds from sales of shares under the prospectus except amounts received when Public Warrants are exercised.
On November 16, 2026, the last reported XRPN share price was $7.45 and the last reported XRPNW warrant price was $1.33.

The maximum arithmetic gross proceeds from exercise of all 11,499,992 registered Public Warrants at $11.50 would be $132,249,908, but this is a theoretical registration ceiling, not actual proceeds and not the number of warrants remaining after prior exercises.
limitations: The 11,499,992 figure is the registered Public Warrant share ceiling, not proof that this many warrants remained outstanding on November 17.
Do not add this prospectus ceiling to the 10-Q's warrant totals; they refer to related warrant classes and must be reconciled at the aggregate level.
November 16 market prices are a dated snapshot, not current prices or evidence of exercise.

claims_supported: Permission describes ASK as its token for data ownership, consent and rewards-driven advertising.
Permission announced ASK on Base and said users could trade it through Coinbase Wallet.
The blog lists Base contract 0xBB146326778227A8498b105a18f84E0987A684b4.
limitations: This is a Permission ecosystem token; no direct XRP Ledger, Ripple or XRP utility relationship is established by this source.

claims_supported: The documentation identifies ASK as a LayerZero OFT token and lists Base contract 0xBB146326778227A8498b105a18f84E0987A684b4 and Polygon contract 0xaA3717090CDDc9B227e49d0D84A28aC0a996e6Ff as official contracts.
The documentation states that these are the only official ASK contracts authorized by Permission and describes Stargate bridging.
limitations: Contract-address pages can change; any on-chain ingestion must capture the current page and independently verify chain, code, token metadata and migration status.

claims_supported: Permission announced that its ASK wallet moved to Coinbase embedded-wallet infrastructure.
Permission states Coinbase holds wallet keys on the user's behalf under user authority and that Permission no longer holds the wallet keys.
limitations: This is a direct wallet-infrastructure relationship between Permission and Coinbase, not evidence of a Ripple, XRP or XRPL partnership.

claims_supported: CoinGecko reports that Wormhole-bridged ASK on Base migrated to a new LayerZero contract and that users must repatriate to Polygon before bridging back to Base through LayerZero.
CoinGecko's listed Base and Polygon contracts align with Permission's current contract documentation.
limitations: Secondary source; use Permission's official contract documentation as canonical and preserve the older 2025 Base contract announcement as historical evidence.

A separate January 15, 2025 Permission press release listed a different Base address, 0x79322cee6c90735b967d2396b9adc392915aebb6; its current status is unresolved and it must not be treated as canonical without issuer confirmation.

confirmed_cash_events.event: Private-placement subscription cash received; issuer says cash was used to purchase 84,365,876 XRP.
Aggregate gross cash proceeds at business-combination close: approximately $224.6M private-placement investments plus $48.0M SPAC trust release, before transaction expenses.
Convertible note proceeds; approximately $30M gross and $29M net after a $1M capital-markets advisor fee.
Cash proceeds from exercise of 3,073,366 warrants.

in_kind_xrp_events.event: Private-placement XRP contributions relating to subscription agreements.
Aggregate investor XRP contributions in kind at closing.
Ripple contribution to Pathfinder under a common-control contribution agreement.
RippleWorks contribution to Arrington XRP Capital Fund, LP, then subscription consideration.
Contribution by a Ripple-affiliated contributor entity under a separate subscription agreement.

contingent_or_optional_capacity.event: Theoretical maximum gross proceeds if all 11,499,992 registered Public Warrants were exercised at $11.50.
Optional ELOC capacity; 97% of applicable VWAP subject to purchase notices and conditions.

reconciliation_notes: The 10-Q reports 11,739,645 total warrants assumed at closing; 3,073,366 exercised plus 8,666,279 remaining equals that total.

The 11/17 prospectus separately registers up to 11,499,992 Public Warrant shares; the 11/13 resale prospectus separately identifies 239,653 Sponsor Warrants. Do not treat the 11,499,992 registered ceiling as remaining warrants after prior exercises.
The 11/16 XRPN share price of $7.45 was below the $11.50 exercise price; this dated observation does not prove future non-exercise.

The phrase 'actual capital' is not used as a formal accounting classification in the reviewed SEC filings. Barrot should classify cash received, cash net of fees, debt proceeds, in-kind XRP, optional facilities, warrant exercise proceeds and unexercised capacity separately.

Do not infer that SBI Holdings itself funded the entire $214.1M private-placement cash amount; the filing establishes SBI-affiliated share issuance and the issuer's aggregate cash, but not a complete investor-by-investor cash reconciliation.

not_established: No direct Permission/ASK to Ripple/XRP/XRPL relationship established.
No direct SBIC East/Central/West to SBI Holdings relationship established by reviewed primary company profiles.
Coinbase principal-market status does not establish Evernorth or Pathfinder XRP custody by Coinbase.
Potential XRP-secured financing and yield strategies in Evernorth/Pathfinder disclosures do not establish an executed collateral loan or deployed yield position.

ask_coin_reconciliation.coinbase_relationship: Permission announced ASK on Base/Coinbase Wallet in January 2025 and moved its wallet to Coinbase embedded-wallet infrastructure in September 2026. This is a Permission-Coinbase relationship, not a Ripple/XRP relationship.

ask_coin.result: Permission Coin (ASK) is the best-supported candidate entity for ASK; exact phrase searches do not establish a distinct XRP-linked ASK Coin.

actual_capital.result: No formal accounting term or single scalar was established. SEC filings support a structured reconciliation of cash received, net proceeds, debt, warrant exercise cash, in-kind XRP, optional ELOC capacity and unexercised warrants.

sbic_chatgpt_sibc.result: No independently indexed primary evidence for the exact phrase or a formal OpenAI partnership with the regional SBIC companies was found.
